# Medical Billing and Coding

> A comprehensive resource for aspiring and practicing medical billing and coding professionals, covering education, certification, career guidance, and salary information.

Medical Billing and Coding is a dedicated educational platform helping individuals pursue careers in healthcare billing and coding. The site provides training materials, school directories, certification preparation resources, and employment guidance aligned with industry standards like AAPC CPC certification and HIPAA compliance.

## Key Topics

- Medical Billing and Coding
- AAPC Certification
- Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
- CPT/ICD/HCPCS Coding Standards
- HIPAA Compliance
- Medicare and Medicaid
- Healthcare Careers
- Medical Coding Training
- Career Guidance
- Salary Information
- Certification Exam Preparation
- Online Education Programs
- Healthcare Employment
- AHIMA
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics

## Getting Started

- [Is an Online Medical Billing and Coding Program Right for You?](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org): Homepage introducing online medical billing and coding programs with career guidance.
- [What is Medical Billing & Coding?](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/what-is-mbac): Video tutorial introducing medical billing and coding fundamentals.
- [What is Medical Coding?](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/coding-training): Training guide covering CPT, ICD, and HCPCS medical coding standards.
- [What is Medical Billing?](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/billing-training): Training videos on medical billing, Medicare, Medicaid, and HIPAA compliance.

## Education & Training

- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/schools): Directory of medical billing and coding schools with certification information.
- [Billing and Coding Schools by State](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/states): Database of medical billing and coding schools organized by state.
- [Certification Prep](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/certification-prep): AAPC CPC exam preparation guide with study strategies and test-taking tips.
- [Resources for Billers and Coders](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/resources): Comprehensive resource guides covering HIPAA, financial aid, and healthcare standards.

## Career Guidance

- [MBAC at Work](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/mbac-at-work): Real-world overview of medical billing and coding job responsibilities.
- [Advice](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/advice): Career guidance on job search, school selection, and industry growth prospects.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Salary Averages by State](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/salary): Salary data by state with BLS employment statistics and credential impact.

## State-Specific Resources

- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in California](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/california): California schools, employers, and salary data for medical billing/coding.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in Alaska](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/alaska): Alaska-specific schools, employers, and salary information guide.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in Alabama](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/alabama): Alabama schools and healthcare employers directory with career guide.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in Arizona](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/arizona): Arizona schools, employers, and career guide for billing and coding.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in Arkansas](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/arkansas): Arkansas schools, employers, and salary information for medical billing/coding.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in Colorado](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/colorado): Colorado schools, employers, and salary information for medical careers.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in Connecticut](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/connecticut): Connecticut schools, employers, and training programs directory.
- [Medical Billing and Coding Schools in Hawaii](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/hawaii): Hawaii-specific schools, hospital employers, and career opportunities.

## Support & FAQs

- [Questions & Answers](https://www.medicalbillingandcoding.org/qnas): FAQ addressing certification exams, program types, and career guidance questions.
